headline: A 2004 executive order changes how the federal government manages and oversees its intelligence agencies.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order aims to strengthen central management of the US intelligence community, the group of federal agencies that collect and analyze intelligence. No summary was provided, so the specific rules and powers it changes are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: US intelligence agencies and their leaders
who_it_affects.how: The order appears to change how these agencies are directed and coordinated.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed August 27, 2004; the source does not state a separate effective date.
